summary.headline: SAMPLE: Lead with Lagos music culture, then test a small capsule collaboration
summary.overview: SAMPLE PLAN with synthetic data. The (synthetic) evidence links this brand's audience to Afrobeats and alté artists, adjacent streetwear labels and Lekki nightlife venues. The plan proposes music-led content first, one low-cost collaboration test, and a measurable 14-day experiment.

insights.title: Music is the strongest cultural entry point
insights.finding: Two synthetic artists (ev_001, ev_004) show the highest affinity with this audience.
insights.whyItMatters: Music-led content is likely to feel native to the audience rather than like an ad.
assumptions: Affinity reflects taste, not purchase intent.

insights.title: Adjacent streetwear labels share the same audience
insights.finding: Synthetic Lagos Streetwear Co and Synthetic Danfo Denim are strongly associated with the seed artist.
insights.whyItMatters: These brands are natural benchmarks and possible collaboration partners.
assumptions: Partners may not be open to collaboration.

insights.title: Nightlife is a secondary, local signal
insights.finding: A Lekki venue (ev_005) appears with moderate evidence strength.
insights.whyItMatters: Small in-person activations may work, but evidence is thinner here.

collaborations.culturalConnection: Shared Afrobeats-adjacent audience and denim-plus-graphics aesthetic.
collaborations.fitRationale: High affinity with the seed artist; complementary product rather than direct competitor.
collaborations.testIdea: Pre-order 30 units of one co-branded tee before producing more.
assumptions: Partner is open to a small test.

campaigns.title: Studio-to-street content series
campaigns.objective: Drive pre-orders for the capsule collection
campaigns.targetHypothesis: Fans of the seed artists respond to behind-the-scenes music culture content.
campaigns.culturalInsight: Music is the strongest cultural signal for this audience (ins_1).
campaigns.angle: Behind-the-scenes music culture featuring the collection
execution: Film three short studio-session reels wearing the collection
Post weekly with a pre-order link
Track saves and link clicks per post

experiments.hypothesis: If we run behind-the-scenes music content for Lagos creatives, pre-order link clicks will improve.
experiments.segment: Gen Z and young millennial creatives in Lagos

nextDecision.ifSuccess: Extend the series and test the capsule collaboration.
nextDecision.ifFailure: Try a product-led angle for the next 14 days.
